scope: Explicit focused suites: research, existing paper ledger, new event lifecycle, runner
fault_scenarios_exercised: Duplicate event and execution deliveries across restarts
Concurrent duplicate execution commits exactly once
Concurrent orders cannot oversubscribe reserved cash
Fill before acknowledgement and after cancellation acknowledgement
UNKNOWN state persists across cancellation until reconciliation
New contradictory terminal fill is quarantined
Missing/conflicting reconciliation executions do not invent balancing entries
Forced process death inside uncommitted SQLite transaction
Injected failure after INSERT before COMMIT rolls back
New process reconstructs matching cash, positions and state hash
CLI help and status work without GUI, broker or LLM imports
Runner rejects missing/changed sources, zero tests, skips and failures
limitations: Full git clone blocked by container DNS; assembled source subset, not full checkout
No full legacy GUI/risk-manager suite, installed distribution or Windows runtime test
No actual MCP host, network data feed, broker account or real-money execution
All fill data explicit simulation; no market matching or profitability evidence
Hash chains/triggers are not cryptographic authenticity against a filesystem owner
No power-loss, network-filesystem, broker settlement, correction or corporate-action test
